audio.text: You're not still working on that essay, are you?

options: I'm just giving it one last read.
No, I'm not working this semester.
The essay is about climate policy.
Yes, I'm still waiting for you.

why.en: An indirect "yes": the final reading. B uses "working" with a different meaning.
why.tr: Dolaylı "evet": son okuma. B "working" kelimesini başka anlamda kullanıyor.
